documents.title: Synthetic restaurant air-conditioner troubleshooting reference
documents.content: Synthetic troubleshooting reference: preserve personnel safety, document the observed symptom, check only externally visible conditions, and escalate cooling, temperature, noise, vibration, water leakage, condensation, airflow, fan, odor, smoke, power, or start-stop abnormalities to authorized maintenance. Treat every possible cause as preliminary until physical inspection, and require human review before inspection, repair, isolation, or any electrical action.
